**What this changes and why**

**Tests**
- [ ] a test fails before this change and passes after it
- [ ] `make test` passes; `make lint` is clean

**Provenance**
- [ ] every new reference, tool or claim carries its source, release and checksum where applicable
- [ ] no sample, report, read or name from a real person is in the diff (fixtures use the published identifiers in `openbiota/samples.py`)

**Report**
- [ ] any number the report prints is computed once and read wherever it appears
- [ ] report text is plain, sourced, and says what it does not know

Signed-off-by (`git commit -s`) confirms the [DCO](CONTRIBUTING.md#before-you-start).
